Server gauges

Scraped from the server's own Prometheus endpoint. A gauge the server does not export says so rather than drawing a flat zero.

Requests over time

One bar per proxied request. The hatched head is everything before the first token — queueing and prefill; the solid tail is decode. Colour is how much of the prompt came from the prefix cache. Dashed lines mark evictions and pressure. Click a bar to open its attribution.

Prefix cache

Reconstructed from the prompts flowing through the proxy and the cached-token counts the server reports back. SGLang's radix cache has no TTL: a prefix lives until the pool is full and it is the least recently used, so the panel reports idle time and eviction rank instead of a countdown.

Requests

Open a row for the latency waterfall: where the time went, and how much of that is measured.

Everything the collectors saw, newest first.
